attribution.editorial_statement: Bangla explanation and examples adapted and written for Ovidhan.

bangla_explanation.text: জীবিত বা নির্জীব যাই হোক, যাকে নিজের আলাদা অস্তিত্ব হিসেবে ধরা হয়।

definition.oewn_definition: that which is perceived or known or inferred to have its own distinct existence (living or nonliving)
definition.text: that which is perceived or known or inferred to have its own distinct existence (living or nonliving)

examples.bn: কমিটি লাইব্রেরিকে স্কুল অফিস থেকে আলাদা এক সত্তা হিসেবে দেখল।
examples.en: The committee treated the library as an entity separate from the school office.
